notes.title: Update 2.4 - Improved performance
notes.content: This update improves performance for older and slower systems. Improvements relate to RAM and VRAM usage as well as loading times.

notes.title: Update 2.36 - Compactor Photo Sensor and bugfixes
notes.content:
New functionality

 You can now purchase an automatic photo sensor for all compactor containers (SPB, MPB, APB, Shark and Midi LM). This will automatically turn on and off the compactor based on the current fill level of the hopper.
 The message "A skip is full" will now also display the container type and trash type.


Bugfixes

 Fixed the problem that the rear gate would not open with the tow truck for some players
 Improved functionality of the document shredder and used clothing box to avoid trash objects getting stuck or lost in the containers

notes.title: Update 2.35 - Bugfix Container Truck Expansion and more
notes.content:

Base game

 Improved audio volume balance


Container Truck Expansion

 Improved unloading physics fixed a problem when containers could not be unloaded completely or would become instable

notes.title: Update 2.1 - The backpack, skip auto-save and more
notes.content:
You can now purchase the backpack in your Recycling Center shop. The backpack allows you to carry up to 8 small trash items at once. This will make it a lot easier and quicker to take care of a customer with multiple seperate items!

Some additional bugfixes and improvements include:


 Menu to empty containers (DLC Container Truck Expansion) can now also be triggered by controller

notes.title: Update 2.01 - Fixed issue with cleaning containers
notes.content: Small update that fixes a bug with container cleaning.

notes.title: Update 2.0 - Saving Container Contents
notes.content:
Dear players,

the final weekly update brings you game version 2.0 and includes big changes behind the scenes.

A feature requested by many players has been included and required modifications to the game structure and source code.

Trash collected in the containers will now be stored together with the savegames. That way you can pile up large amounts of garbage until the container finally needs to be emptied.

Based on these changes, a fee is now applied when emptying the containers based on the container volume. 

Please check out the upcoming DLC "Container Truck Expansion" with the new trailer video: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2852900/Mein_Recyclinghof__Container_Truck_Expansion/

This addon will be available soon.

Hint: Saving trash objects only works in the container's storage volume, it does not apply to the hopper of the compactors or the ground of your yard.

notes.title: Update 1.93 - New Compactor Container Midi LM, more trash items
notes.content:
This update introduces the compact, fast and well-priced Compactor Container Midi LM. It is recommended for Recyclables, Residential Trash and Organic Waste. As a skip lift container, it takes up little space and can be placed on the front slots of the yard without issues.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/7a898f101096e8934d7423b5fbd7173ba4645572.png

24 new trash items add on to the large amount of now over 600 different objects. The new objects are categorized as Appliances, Electric Devices, Used Clothes, Bulk Trash and Timber.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/50d99535f7549ba63ccb842f26376054206239a6.png

Available soon: The DLC "Container Truck Expansion" introduces skip and hooklift trucks and a realistic waste processing plant. Load your full containers onto the trucks and take them to the dump. Check it out and wishlist now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/7038fe538df5b90400e62d82cb671a8af5da9941.png

notes.title: Update 1.92 - Trash Focus View, new Items, Fast Cleaning
notes.content:
The new trash focus view can be triggered by pressing Tab and will make it easy to find and collect every trash item of your customer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/cbb5373ac7beb48c31ec018e88486f6b3998c7e7.jpg

This mode also allows you to select trash through car walls and seats.

Site upgrades like fences, office containers, signs and licenses can now be sold and deactivated.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/3b6a805c62e04a7eb831a1ae20166a57eed78c1c.png

The container cleaning process can be skipped for a fee to save time. The container will get clean instantly, but you won't get any satisfaction reward.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/386defef096eba7f8124b0b04cc62dc1f5736dbe.png

More variety in collecting and crushing trash: 27 new objects for Bulk Waste, Timber, Construction Waste and Scrap Metal.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/5b458c1f374222b1fec9db56027fc809aa3fb656.png

Also includes the following fixes:


 Changed controller mapping for picking up trash
 Changed wrong trash type of the oven to Scrap Metal
 Fixed blue cardboard box error
 Added trash focus view to tutorial
 Improved interior collision of car A3

notes.title: Update 1.91 - Commercial Waste Trucks, new trash items and upgrades
notes.content:
You can now get the new license for commercial waste trucks in the in-game shop. Trade customers will deliver large amounts of trash in a truck, randomly generated from one of these trash types: Bulk Waste, Timber, Cardboard, Scrap Metal, Electric Devices, Household Appliances, Scrap Tires, Residential Waste or Recyclables.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/f11eeb8387728636bb30a0d6ca6141dd62e9f20c.jpg

A new upgrade for compactor containers is available: The high-performance hydraulic pump. It will make your compactors faster and more quiet!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/3effc729f371511f03629bfdbdcd786cd96e40aa.png

As requested by users, the document shredder now can be equipped with a photo sensor.

32 new trash items have been added for extra variety. Trash types: TImber, Scrap Metal, Electric Devices, Residential Waste, Cardboard and Bulk Waste.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/0ba6e4ad3cfd3e133c205139a5ce6e0cece7eab3.png

Also a number of small improvements are included:


 Improved physics of drum compactor
 Bug of container fill percent display fixed
 Easier to pick up distant trash items
 Additional reward (satisfaction) when entry gate opened quickly

notes.content:
Unlock the new trash type Organic Waste if you have a sufficient satisfaction level. 

Many new objects have been added, such as kitchen waste, used coffee filters, banana or orange peels.

notes.title: Update 1.8 - New Cars, Trailer and Crammed Compactors
notes.content:
3 new car models add plenty of variation to your customers. With all paint schemes together, this brings 17 new versions of cars.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/b3e55a0baae898ad375797453585a939869c60c2.png

The new twin-axle trailer with a huge loading space brings in large piles of trash into your daily routine at the recycling center.

Another new feature: Compactor Containers will actually get crammed and fill up. The warning light will light up when they get 75% percent full.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/c6eb9a93004398024033e5129ccd05ddff10f3f2.png

You will notice changes in compacting force and speed when the compactor is starting to struggle.

The management page will show the current fill state in percent.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/b67f862c09d42048ffb453e77b612ac6846436ee.png

Additional improvements were made to the shredder and electric test station's physics.

notes.title: Update 1.7 - Document Destruction, Sell Containers and more
notes.content:
Unlock the new Document Destruction service and buy the authentic industrial shredder which will eat files, folders and stacks of paper with no problems.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/85e2ef37d6d4e29e9ba48ccbb4a834381b29e760.jpg

Customers will pay fees for reliable disposal of confidential data.

45 new objects were added to display files, folders and documents.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/7b6dd6a3dbbb92ed84cedc36f47128c631623639.png

In addition, you are now able to sell containers. The sale value will depend on the upgrades of the container, but also on how clean it is!

As requested by players, the physics and controls of the barrow and cart were re-designed from scratch.

We also added a progress bar when using the pressure washer and some minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Update 1.61
notes.content: Hotfix for physics problem that would sometimes cause trash not to be compacted

notes.title: Update 1.6 - "Shark" Compactor Container
notes.content:
The new compactor container "Shark" is now available! A large, powerful compactor perfectly suited for Bulk Trash, Timber and Waste Paper.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/cbc6028a9426d8fe0a36b11daabe61894fe286f7.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649917/c32e03d01cb6032e63fa2c3b058cbd68216b4434.jpg

Also, the achievement "Full Diversity" can now be unlocked correctly. This was not possible until now because of a bug. For compensation, 3 additional new achievements were added.

Player's wishes have been heard: You can now purchase the photosensor for the garden waste shredder. This will make the machine turn on and off automatically. 

In addition, some physics improvements were made for the delivering cars.

notes.title: Update 1.5 - Used Clothes and Shoes
notes.content:
The new collecting box for used clothes and shoes is now available for your yard. Unlock the new used clothing trash type with 37 new trash objects. Use the animated trap door on the container to discard old clothes and shoes.

The update also contains small bug fixes.

notes.title: Update 1.4 - Electric Device Testing Station
notes.content:
You can now purchase the Electric Device Testing Station as an extension of the Second-Hand Shop.

This Testing Station will be placed on any free slot on your site. When a customer brings in electric devices or appliances to discard, you can use it to quickly test the old appliances and offer them for sale if they pass the test.

Your yard will also be expanded by 8 additional slots to make room for more free updates in the future!

Improvements:

 New upgrade for purchase: Electric Device Testing Station
 Yard is expanded by 8 additional slots
 Physics and trigger updates for containers to improve container emptying procedure
 FPS performance of the tyre shredder improved
 Mouse-click trigger for Garden Waste Chopper improved
 Modified trash spawns on trailers to avoid trash falling off

notes.title: Update 1.3 - Second Hand Shop
notes.content:
You can now purchase the second-hand shop building for your recycling center. Offer re-usable goods for sale and save them from the crusher. 

The shop building also includes an office for your site management.
